steps.caption: Health audit
steps.narration: Here's how to read a health audit across client accounts.

steps.caption: A finding
steps.narration: Each finding names the account, says what was found, how serious it is, and offers a fix.

steps.caption: Filters
steps.narration: Filters narrows the list by severity.

steps.caption: Needs attention
steps.narration: Choose Needs attention to see only what needs work.

steps.caption: Search terms with no conversions
steps.narration: Fourteen search terms spent money with no reported conversions in the last thirty days.

steps.caption: Budget-limited campaign
steps.narration: One campaign lost more than a tenth of its search impression share to budget.

steps.caption: Call tracking
steps.narration: Review call tracking: this account has no enabled call-related actions.

steps.caption: Disapproved ads
steps.narration: Two disapproved ads, with a link to review them in Google Ads.

steps.caption: A fix for each finding
steps.narration: Each finding links to its fix: a protection preview here, or the right place in Google Ads.

steps.caption: Could not be checked
steps.narration: Now choose Could not be checked.

steps.caption: Not a pass
steps.narration: When Google doesn't return a check, the audit says so. That is never a pass.

steps.caption: Information
steps.narration: Zero disapproved ads on this account, marked Information.

steps.caption: Menu: Health audit
steps.narration: Health audit is in the Agency Ads and LSA menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to read a Google Ads health audit for clients | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Health audit in the ConstructHUB Agency Ads & LSA manager. You will filter findings by severity, read the search-term, budget, call-tracking and disapproved-ad checks, see that an unanswered check is never a pass, and find the fix each finding links to.
